how: THE READING OF THE UNMARKED LINES, 2026-11-18. These lines stood under record web-wf24-05, verified; no sorter had marked them, so main had not read them one by one. Main read all 990 such lines of the lane against their records' grounds. Narrowed: line 68: a definition; line 69: the theorem's hypothesis.
note: The parent's ground is unchanged for its other lines.
